title: Norpix sequence
description: A Norpix StreamPix sequence (.seq), as dev's Sequence stack: raw grayscale images of 8 or 16 bits (height x width x frames) or raw BGR images (height x width x 3 x frames, in RGB order), with the frame rate of its header. Several files of a recording are joined in natural order. Read a chunk at a time; read only.
